svg.title: C4 L3 — **frontend** internals: 10 App-Router API routes, the lib/ layer, the component tree

g.text: internals: 10 App-Router API routes, the lib/ layer, the component tree
The SSE answer path is drawn thick in edge blue
frontend — Next.js 15 App Router · React 19 · TypeScript · output:'standalone'
Browser bundle — no auth, no CSP, no middleware.ts (next.config.mjs:1-8)
Next.js server runtime — all 10 routes are runtime:'nodejs' + dynamic:'force-dynamic', and ZERO of them authenticate
frontend / edge (components + lib + API routes' client contract)
orchestrator / app logic (the Node-side route handlers)
inference / GPU (not present at this level)
storage / data (localStorage only at this level)
= the SSE answer path, request leg and stream leg.
Amber notes = swallowed error, unbounded resource or missing timeout.
Red notes = a defect that changes behaviour or security posture.
Arrow labels read: protocol · payload · sync|async.
